snippet.title: Lost in a FairyTale - Official Trailer | Dark Fairy Tale Survival Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam (search "Lost in a FairyTale"):
store.steampowered.com/app/5507820

Lost in a FairyTale is a 2D survival crafting game set in a dark fairy tale world. Gather resources, craft tools, build your camp, and keep the fire burning through the night. The witch, the wolf and other fairy tale villains are coming for you.

Coming to Steam Early Access.

Follow the journey:
X: x.com/LostFairyTaleHQ
TikTok: tiktok.com/@lostinafairytalegame
Instagram: instagram.com/lost_in_a__fairytale
Twitch: twitch.tv/lostinafairytalegame

Developed by Pepper Games

#LostInAFairyTale #SurvivalGame
